evidence.source: Taiwan Ministry of Education, Variant Dictionary
evidence.field: 正字／說文釋形／釋義
evidence.text: The entry gives 遠 as “遼也。从辵，袁聲” and identifies 𨖸 as an ancient form. It records spatial and temporal distance, figurative depth, and kinship remoteness separately; it also records 遠去聲 for “keep away.” Its examples include the Shijing line “取彼斧斨，以伐遠揚” and the I Ching phrase “其旨遠.”
evidence.title: [A04172] 遠 — 教育部《異體字字典》

evidence.source: 漢語多功能字庫, Chinese University of Hong Kong
evidence.field: 形義通解／甲骨、金文、戰國簡用例
evidence.text: The database analyzes oracle-bone 遠 as 彳 (road/walking semantic element) plus 袁 phonetic, and bronze 遠 as 辵 plus 袁 phonetic. It cites oracle-bone 《屯南》3759 contrasting 遠 and 邇 in a hunting context, bronze inscriptions on 晉姜鼎 and 番生簋蓋 referring to distant and near peoples, and Warring States bamboo texts using 遠 in distance, kinship, and figurative contexts. It describes the oracle-bone 袁 graph as an earlier graph later expanded with 彳 or 辵 for 遠; its account of the earliest 袁 graph and its referent includes competing interpretations, including a proposal that it depicts handling clothing. These are the database’s analyses, not independent confirmation of every graphic interpretation.
evidence.title: 漢語多功能字庫 — 遠

evidence.source: 漢語多功能字庫, Chinese University of Hong Kong
evidence.field: 袁 component analysis
evidence.text: The database says oracle-bone 袁 forms include 衣 and 又, while noting an alternative interpretation that the graph depicts putting on clothing and may be an early form of 擐. It reports that 袁 is used in oracle-bone inscriptions for personal names and also for “distant place,” and proposes that 遠 was formed by adding 彳 or 辵 to 袁. The possible object or original referent depicted by 袁 remains uncertain; that uncertainty does not negate this source’s explicit analysis of 袁 as the sound element in 遠.
evidence.title: 漢語多功能字庫 — Oracle component 袁

evidence.field: 遠 entry

gaps: The exact Unicode kMandarin records for 遠 U+9060 and 元 U+5143 could not be opened despite direct attempts. Local Unihan rows were checked, but the external-record requirement remains unmet.
No exact local Baxter–Sagart 袁 row was provided or checked. The available exact local rows support only a separate 元-versus-遠 reading comparison; they cannot supply 袁’s reconstruction.

The earliest depicted object or original referent of oracle-bone 袁 is disputed in the inspected paleographic source. No independently established ancient name/pronunciation for such an object was found, and none is needed to report the source’s phonetic-component analysis.

The earliest cited attestation establishes spatial distance. The chronology linking spatial distance to profound/deep, social or kinship remoteness, and the verbal sense ‘keep away’ remains undemonstrated by dated examples in this research pass.

The opened sources did not verify the packet’s specific claim that the 遠/远 form occurs in Longkan Shoujian (997). The Ministry dictionary instead supports 远 as a variant cited in Song-Yuan-era俗字谱 material, without dating each specimen individually.
No source license or bulk-reuse permission was verified for recurring dictionary material; retain character-specific citations and concise paraphrases rather than recommend a local extract.
Direct official Unicode Unihan record pages for 遠 U+9060, 元 U+5143, and 袁 U+8881 could not be opened; local kMandarin rows were checked separately.

The Commons original image link for 遠-oracle.svg was exposed by its inspected description page, but fetching the image URL returned a cache miss. The seal-script image page was inspected, but no direct image fetch or pixel inspection was performed.

The earliest depicted referent of 袁 is disputed by the paleographic source; no independent object name or pronunciation was established. This is not required for reporting 袁 as the source-identified phonetic element in 遠.
Sources support early spatial distance and later Warring States spatial, kinship and figurative examples, but the dated path to ‘profound/deep’ and verbal ‘keep away’ is not established here.

The packet’s claim that 远 itself occurs in 龍龕手鑑 (997) was not verified: the Ministry page provides a record for the work but does not expose the relevant text in the inspected page. No conclusion about that specific form’s occurrence is drawn.
No recurring-source bulk-reuse permission was verified; no local source extract is recommended.
